Title: Sales Agent credit balance has the shape the header pill reads
Preconditions: Sales Agent with an active plan
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` 1 (number); `data.leads` has numeric `total_credit` and `used_credit`, plus `package_name`; `is_subscription_expired` boolean; `unread_route_count` / `unread_list_count` numbers (the dashboard tile badges)

Title: Business Sales Agent credits come from the manager allotment
Preconditions: Business Sales Agent under a Business Agent
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` 1; `data.leads.alloted_credits` is a number (manager-allotted credits); no `package_name` on the row (the BSA has no plan of its own)

Title: Recent activity returns at most five items
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` 1; `data` is an array of ≤ 5 items (the controller takes the latest 5 for `recent`)

Title: A missing token gets 401 without server internals
Expected result: HTTP 401 with a message. **No `debug` block** (file, line, trace). Today staging returns the Dingo `debug` block, so this is a known gap until `API_DEBUG` is off on staging
